Karlach can be romanced. The following sections explain Karlach's romance-specific storyline and unique mechanics.

Act One

In Act One, the player character can flirt with Karlach several times. This does not directly impact or progress the romance with her, though it can advance approval enough to allow for one to begin. Two examples:

  1. After giving Karlach her first upgrade from  Dammon, the player character can say, "I still can't touch you, though". Karlach then asks if the player character wants to. Replying, "Of course I do" results in +10 approval.
  2. After taking down the Paladins of Tyr, the player character can tell Karlach that she looks "Hot" after her rage (+3 approval).

Visiting the player character at night

This scene is bugged and no longer triggers without mods. As a result, Karlach's romance can only start at the tiefling celebration.

If the player character reaches 30 approval with Karlach and is not double-dating, Karlach visits them at night and confesses her feelings. This unlocks romance specific dialogue trees at the camp celebration, which vary depending on whether the player character chooses to date Karlach or to remain friends during this romance scene. There is not much wiggle room to get 30 approval before the celebration. Refer to Karlach's approval guide.

Hot tip: The flames around Karlach visibly increase whenever she gets excited, particularly when turned on. (sparks literally fly during kisses). When she is very excited, her flames can become hot enough to turn blue.[1]

The player character is not able to touch Karlach during the first romance scene since it is not possible to progress ⁠The Hellion's Heart past the first step in Act One. However, she can be convinced to try a brief kiss – which the player character can either end quickly or embrace the moment. Both options result in burnt lips, but with different dialogue.

Goblin hunt celebration at camp

The camp celebration at the end of the ⁠Save the Refugees quest is a key moment in Karlach's romance story. Regardless of approval, the player character can inform Karlach how much they like her, with the following outcomes (requirements below each):

  1. Accept as 1st choice – Karlach excitedly agrees to visit the player character after everybody else goes to sleep that night (during Long Rest).
    • The player character has an approval of 20 or higher and no other romance scenes were initiated during the camp celebration.
  2. Accept as 2nd choice – Karlach comments on the player character's already-planned romance scene (see below). However, she still awkwardly asks if the player character wants to spend time with her later instead.
    • The player character has an approval of 20 or higher and no more than one other active romance.
    • If option 2 - "I'd really like that." is selected, then Karlach joyously accepts and immediately plans to meet up later.
    • If option 3 - "You. Me. Bed. Now." is selected, Karlach wrestles with herself, stating, "I don't think your little friend would let me hear the end of it if I accepted. No matter how much I wanted to." before giving in to her desires by saying, "And I... I really want to. Ugh. This is bad. But I want to be bad with you."
  3. Reject on 1st interaction – Karlach declines, stating "Ah, c'mon, let's not spoil an effective thing. You point, I rage, we win. Doesn't need to be more complicated than that."
    • The player character has an approval of 19 or lower.
    • The player character has an approval of 20 or higher, but is dating two or more companions already.
    • The player character was partnered (i.e. had a romance scene) with anyone else before the camp celebration began
  4. Reject on 2nd interaction – Karlach declines further conversation, stating, "Cheers to you, soldier. And to me, if I do say so myself."
    • Happens when the player character interacts with Karlach and rejects her by choosing option 4 "Enjoy yourself tonight, Karlach." or option 5 "Leave", then attempts to speak with her again.

Karlach's romance scene is identical whether initiated before the celebration, during as 1st choice, or during as 2nd choice. When done as the 2nd choice, the other companions do not appear to react in any way to being stood up that night.

Karlach's remarks on the player character's existing romance with other companions

  •  Lae'zel - "Speaking of, I hate to butt in, but I've seen the way you and Lae'zel have been looking at each other. I like her, and I bet she's a wildcat after midnight, but I'm just not sure I trust her yet. Mind yourself, all right? But hey. At least some of us are getting a little action.
  •  Astarion - "Speaking of possibilities, what's this I've been hearing about you and Astarion? Don't get me wrong, I'd ride him to the Feywild and back if I had the chance, but I wouldn't let my guard down around him. Good to see the two of you getting along, anyway. At least one of us is getting a little action."
  •  Gale - "Take you and Gale, for instance. Don't think I haven't noticed the sparks flying. He's a good egg. A little scholarly for my tastes, but I'm sure you could crack his spine like a new book."
  •  Shadowheart - "Speaking of, from where I'm standing it looks like you and Shadowheart are getting more... familiar. She's a funny one. All pointy and secretive, but it seems like there's someone very sweet beneath it all, you know?"
  •  Wyll - "Then we have you and Wyll, the ultimate incarnation of all things good in the world. There's something between you two, isn't there? He's a good one. The best, maybe. When I think about what he sacrificed for me... Give him something to smile about, all right?"
  • Note – "a little action" comment:
    • With Lae'zel, Karlach adds, "But hey. At least some of us are getting a little action."
    • With everyone else, Karlach adds, "Good to see the two of you getting along, anyway. At least one of us is getting a little action."

From the beginning, Karlach expresses frustration at not being able to act on her desires with the player character. She comments often on her pent-up urges, and ends the first romance scene early to pleasure herself after getting too worked up.

Attempts at cooling off

After reciprocating her feelings during the first romance scene, it is possible to tell her how much the player character would love to touch her. Karlach follows up on this the morning after or on the next evening before a long rest, asking the player character if they have any leads. If the player expresses confusion, Karlach says, "There's got to be something, right? Something cold - or water! Or maybe if you were less... burnable. There's a thought, right?"

The player character can figure out a way to cool her down with  Water or ⁠⁠Cold magic for a lightest lip touch, continuing into a discussion of letting the player character have fun with others while she is unavailable due to her engine.

Act Two

Once Act Two is reached and the party have arrived at the Last Light Inn, Karlach's engine can be repaired with the help of  Dammon. During the next long rest (and if no other events are queued), the player character can have sex with her or cuddle together.

Partnering with another companion before Karlach's Act Two scene takes place ends the relationship with Karlach. Typically, romanced companions confront the player character if they partner up with someone else first. However, because Karlach's confrontation is bugged, the player never has an opportunity to choose her over someone else.

If the evening romance scene is not triggered by the time the party leave Act Two, then Karlach terminates the relationship upon arriving in Act Three. After completing ⁠The Chosen of Shar, a solidifying romance event with her cannot be triggered anymore - it is too late.

Act Three

After entering the Lower City, Karlach asks to have a "first date" at her favourite restaurant. If the player character accepts, they meet at The Singing Lute, where she pretends to be only just meeting them - with varying levels of success. They ask each other getting-to-know-you questions over dinner and a drink, which their server,  Henk, gets horribly wrong. The conversation paths can reveal more of Karlach's approach to love, life and the possibility that hers may not have much time left. Near the end of the meal, she professes her love and commitment to the player character. At the end of the date, Karlach reveals she has rented a private room for the night in the inn upstairs, and the player character can agree to accompany her there.

As with her previous romance scene, there is a choice between intimacy scenes: sexual and non-sexual ("I'll happily head upstairs with you, but I want to make sure I'm clear about not wanting to sleep together.").

In the Circus of the Last Days, the player can take  Zethino's love test with Karlach.

Karlach always declines a foursome with the drow twins at Sharess' Caress, but is supportive if the player character has sex with either twin individually.[2] Karlach neither gains nor loses approval from hiring one of the twins.

If the player character chooses to have sex with  Mizora, they are confronted by Karlach afterwards. She is deeply hurt and, regardless of whether the player apologizes for or justifies their behavior, demands an ultimatum for their relationship. Depending on dialogue choices, the player character can continue their relationship with Karlach, break up and go back to being just friends, or permanently kick Karlach out of the party.

Romance mechanics

This section contains information regarding the unique in-game mechanics and interactions for Karlachs's romance.

Relationship stages

Like the other major romance options in the game, Karlach's relationship progression can be divided into specific stages: friendly, dating, partnered, and ex-partnered.

  1. Friendly: When not romanced, Karlach's greetings to the player character are friendly as long as she has at least 10 approval.
  2. Dating: In Act One with high enough approval, the player character can begin dating Karlach.
  3. Partnered: If the player character is still dating Karlach in Act Two, they have the option to progress the relationship with her (via an evening cut-scene) after completing both upgrades to her infernal engine.
  4. Ex-Partnered: Once partnered with Karlach, the player character can break up with her anytime by selecting the appropriate dialogue options.

Unique dialogue

See the "Romantic" columns on Karlach's Banter page for more examples.

Greetings

Player characters who romance Karlach will hear unique greetings dependent on the stage of the romance and approval/game progression:

  • Friendly:
  • "Hey, soldier."
  • "Soldier?"
  • "What's on your mind?"
  • "Copper for your thoughts?"
  • Dating:
  • "Hey, you."
  • "What're you thinking about?"
  • "Oh, hi!"
  • "Hey, soldier." (low approval)
  • "Uh huh?" (low approval)
  • "What is it?" (low approval)
  • Partnered:
  • "Darling."
  • "Hey!"
  • "Soldier?"
  • "Hey, you."
  • "What's on your mind?"
  • "Yeah, honey?" (low approval)
  • "Hmm?" (low approval)
  • Ex-Partnered:
  • "Hey, soldier." (high approval)
  • "Yeah?" (high approval)
  • "What's on your mind?" (high approval)
  • "What?" (low approval)
  • "Yeah?" (low approval)
  • "Something on your mind?" (low approval)

Party/camp interactions

While in the partnered stage (following her relationship progression scene in Act Two), Karlach has the following unique dialogue options that are always available when interacting with her both in camp and while she's in the party, which can be instigated by selecting "About our relationship...":

  • The player character can inquire about Karlach's feelings regarding the relationship. ("Are you happy with how things are between us?")
  • The player character can ask for a kiss. ("Can I kiss you?")
  • The player character can break up with Karlach. ("Karlach, I think things have gone far enough between us.")

As Origin Karlach

Like her Companion counterpart, Origin Karlach's infernal engine presents a challenge to pursuing romance, and her personal story progression affects when and if specific romantic interactions are available with different characters. Before her second upgrade, Karlach is not able to touch her love interest, and romance dialogue adjusts to reflect this. If Karlach partners with someone prior to her second upgrade, she has the option to say "I wish I could kiss you" to her love interest instead of asking for a kiss.

An incomplete list is below:

Astarion

In his Act One romance scene, instead of initiating sex, Astarion becomes frustrated and confused that he cannot touch Karlach. It is possible to suggest they just lay near each other and talk instead, which is a novel concept for him. Karlach still appears naked in the morning.

Astarion’s Act Two romance scene does not account for Karlach’s engine when pressuring him into sex, meaning the implied sex scene (and resulting break-up) happens even if Karlach is not actually able to be touched.

If Astarion does not ascend and Karlach's heart has not been upgraded, he acknowledges this during the graveyard scene and tells that he is willing to wait.

If Astarion ascends, he inevitably breaks up with Karlach. If Karlach accepts his proposal to “fix her” and become his spawn, he is unsuccessful in turning her—he will catch on fire after drinking her blood, whether or not her engine is repaired. Enraged, he breaks up with her. This situation leads to a unique post-break-up dialogue where Astarion accuses her of “rejecting him with her whole body” and concludes she is “doomed”.[3]

However, it is still possible for a romanced Ascended Astarion to accompany Karlach to Avernus. Defeating Cazador and taking the boat to the Morphic Pool without long resting preserves their relationship and its romance wrap-up scene, where Astarion demands she return to Avernus to live and offers to go with her. Accepting his offer proceeds to Karlach’s Avernus ending as normal. Epilogue dialogue implies they are still a couple and, like other Avernus partners, are searching for a way to fix Karlach’s engine.

Wyll

Karlach is able to romance  Wyll in her own origin, and pursuing this option adds a handful of unique lines acknowledging Wyll's prior objective of hunting her down.

Even if Karlach’s engine is not repaired, Wyll insists on dancing with her in his Act Two romance scene. If Karlach protests, Wyll claims he will not be burnt as long as her emotions are kept under control - Karlach can even choose to do "a calm twirl" when dancing. Karlach is unable to kiss Wyll after their dance; despite his subdued reaction to this, however, he still becomes partnered with her afterward.

Wyll heavily encourages Karlach to return to Avernus in their romance wrap-up scene and goes with her, whether it is to ensure she survives or, if he broke his pact, as part of hunting down  Mizora. If Wyll becomes Grand Duke, however, his commitments to Baldur’s Gate render him unable to join her, and their relationship becomes long distance if she goes to Avernus alone. As Grand Duke, Wyll promises to join Karlach in Avernus "once the city's been put to rights after this disaster."

Lae'zel

Karlach can only begin a romance with Lae'zel in Act Two, after receiving her second engine upgrade.[4] If Karlach has 40+ approval with Lae'zel and isn't double-dating or partnered with anyone else, Lae'zel wakes her one night to confess her feelings, challenging her to a duel as a show of affection. If Karlach accepts and rises to the challenge, she can choose to begin a relationship with Lae'zel after the fight.

Gale

If he did not pursue the crown, Gale offers to go to Avernus with Karlach in his romance wrap-up scene. If he became a God, Karlach has to go to Avernus alone to be reunited with him in the epilogue. There, God Gale offers to ascend her and fix her heart.

Halsin

If Karlach is partnered to  Halsin, he does not offer to go to Avernus with her, due to his duty to help heal the former shadowcursed lands.

Minthara

Karlach is not given the option to sleep with  Minthara after completing ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove; however, Minthara can be romanced after recruiting her to the party and upgrading Karlach's engine. In her romance wrap-up scene, Minthara demands to go to Avernus together and make Zariel sorry for ever hurting her, and accepting proceeds to Karlach’s Avernus ending as normal. Otherwise, if the player character refuses, Minthara breaks down and says she does not accept Karlach's choice but will stay with her until she is gone; it is implied that Minthara travels to Avernus anyway to avenge her.

Shadowheart

If Karlach's heart is not upgraded in time for Shadowheart's Act Three romance night, it affects both versions of the scene. Instead of sleeping with Shadowheart after skinnydipping, Karlach can spend the night with her on the beach under the stars—"just near enough." On the Sharran path, Karlach's inability to kiss Shadowheart cuts the Nightfall scene short, with Shadowheart remarking, "A shame. I wanted to show you just how rewarding the embrace of darkness could be... but perhaps it is not meant for you. Good night."

In her final romance wrap-up scene, Shadowheart attempts to persuade Karlach to return to Avernus, and accompanies Karlach if she did not become Mother Superior.

Dammon

 Dammon is necessary to complete ⁠Forging a Heart, allowing Karlach to fully engage in romancing her companions. While he cannot be romanced in any playthrough, his dialogue is more flirtatious when speaking to Origin Karlach. When obtaining the second engine upgrade, Karlach can even (internally) comment on this with 'Pause. Is he flirting with you?'.

Karlach can fantasize about kissing Dammon[5]as an alternative to her threesome fantasy during a long rest alone on the Ravaged Beach. However, this is not possible in normal gameplay, as this scene becomes unavailable after entering the Emerald Grove.

Finding Dammon in Act Three after having already received both engine upgrades has him lamenting his inability to stabilize her engine. He remarks there is something he would have liked to do "in another life", but does not finish the thought.[6]

Mizora

Despite her hatred of all things related to Zariel, Karlach can accept Mizora's one-night stand – unhappily so, especially if Karlach chooses to Smile the rictus grin of the damned when she accepts. As Mizora is a cambion, she is an available sex partner for Karlach even if she has not repaired her engine. (She may say that only she can bear the "fire of Avernus" within Karlach.) In their sex scene, Karlach has more demanding dialogue choices available to her. If she backs out at any time, Mizora is disappointed, saying she had hoped Karlach was ready to come home.

Haarlep

Like Mizora,  Haarlep is of the Hells, so they can be a sex partner for Karlach even if her engine is not fully upgraded.[7]

Notes and references

  1. ↑ If the player character chooses to have sex with Karlach during Act Two and moves the romance to a partnered stage, immediately prior to this event, Karlach expresses her excitement and desire for the player character and burns with a hot-blue flame. The same happens if she is kissed later, after being fully partnered.
  2. ↑ Sharess' Caress, dialogue between Karlach and the player character after propositioning either of the drow twins:
    Karlach: "Have fun, soldier. Leave something left for me later, ey?"
  3. ↑ Campsite, lines spoken by Astarion the morning after his Act 3 romance scene if ascended:
    Astarion: "I tried to give you a gift and you rejected me. Not just you - your whole body!"
    (...)
    Astarion: "You're defective. Broken. Doomed."
  4. ↑ Prior to Hotfix #16, Karlach was able to accept  Lae'zel's camp party proposition. Lae'zel's sex scene proceeded as normal, as if Karlach were not literally too hot to touch. The camp party dialogue now properly addresses her engine, and Lae’zel complains that she has to find relief elsewhere.
  5. ↑ ⁠Baldur's Gate 3 - Karlach's dream about Dammon (Hidden dialogue) – Sparrows
  6. ↑ Lower City, dialogue between Origin Karlach and Dammon if Karlach already received her second infernal engine upgrade in Act Two:
    Dammon: "In another life, I would’ve liked to... well. It doesn’t matter now. Good luck, Karlach. And thank you. Again."
  7. ↑ House of Hope, narrator line when Origin Karlach speaks with Haarlep without her second infernal engine upgrade:
    Narrator: *It suddenly dawns on you: This creature is of the Hells. They could touch without being harmed, if you want them to.*
